narratives.Description: docs(skills): multi-scope build — quality check once at end unless failed
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Multi-scope trials showed `directive check` / quality-gate spam (~17 in one DevHammer run). Framework doctrine wants check before **finish/merge**, not after every scope. Each check adds a turn and often large tool observation into the prompt-cache chain.

## Goal

Encode a multi-scope build contract: **run the quality check once at the end of the batch** (or after the last scope), and only re-run if the last check failed.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `deft-directive-build` (and related multi-scope preambles) state check-once-at-end unless last failed
- [ ] Explicit exception: fix loops after a failed check may re-run check
- [ ] Does not weaken pre-PR / merge-ready gates (those remain end-of-unit)
- [ ] Docs / skill text only is OK for v1 if no new CLI
- [ ] CHANGELOG if skill/user-facing

## Non-goals

- Removing `task check` from merge/PR path
- Auto-suppressing check when hooks require story-ready stack

## Parent

Part of multi-scope turn/cache budget epic (post-v0.90 ceremony).
